title: Accessibility | Apple Developer Documentation - [visionOS](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility\#visionOS)
claim: Minimize the need for large and repetitive gestures, as these can become tiresome and may be difficult depending on a person’s surroundings.
